{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lec|toclimit=2|text=The '''LEC 2024 Winter Season''' is the first split of the second year of the newly merged EMEA's rebranded professional League of Legends league. It is the sixth year of the LEC and the second season following the changed format. In Stage 1, ten teams compete in a single round robin group stage, with the top eight advancing to Playoffs, a double elimination bracket.}}
==Overview==
=== Format ===
* Regular Season (Stage 1):
** 10 teams participate
** Single Round Robin
** Matches are best of one
** Top eight teams advance to [[LEC/2024 Season/Winter Playoffs|Playoffs]]

:''<sup>2</sup> [[KOI (Spanish Team)|KOI]] and '''Infinite Reality''' mutually dissolved their partnership, with '''Infinite Reality''' maintaining control over the slot.<ref>[https://twitter.com/KOI/status/1720569022431760802 KOI's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref> '''Infinite Reality''' returned to the [[Rogue (European Team)|Rogue]] brand.<ref>[https://twitter.com/KOIxENG/status/1727379082218725745 Rogue's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>''
:''<sup>3</sup> [[Excel Esports|EXCEL]] merges with [[Giants (Spanish Team)|Giants]] to form [[GIANTX]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/GIANTXENG/status/1734951352495706227 GIANTX's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>''
:''<sup>4</sup> [[MAD Lions]] partners with [[KOI (Spanish Team)|KOI]] and [[Movistar Riders]] to form [[MAD Lions KOI]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/MADLionsKOI_en/status/1742975851946209347 MAD Lions KOI's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>''
